pr_body:
`RestRequest#getXContentType` cannot normally be `null` for a request with
a non-empty request body, or the rest controll will reject the request, see eg
`RestControllerTests#testUnknownContentWithContentStream`.
This PR fixes sloppy behavior where the `RestRequestFilter` cleared the
`xContentType` field of the filtered request.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/84784
pr_title: Require and preserve content type for filtered rest requests
pr_comment: Hi @albertzaharovits, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: I wonder if it is better to have separate tests that only focus on this copying constructor and content type being null?

I think a test for only the copy-constructor and the xContentType field would be too specific, and would not significantly improve coverage. Ideally, I would've tested the copy-constructor with the `equals` method on the `RestRequest` and also checked that the `xContentType` field (as well as the others) is part of that `equals` check.

But since there's no `equals` method in `RestRequest`, it made think of other ways to test: I noticed that there's the `RestControllerTests#testRestRequest` where I can introduce test coverage for the copy constructor; unfortunately that's not used in the xcontentType test, which got me to the current submission.
